# LinkedIn Post Comments Scraper (No Cookies)

The Apify actor [`harvestapi/linkedin-post-comments`](https://apify.com/harvestapi/linkedin-post-comments) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its default build **0.0.36** (module version **0.1.0**). Runs use whatever build the actor has as default when they start, so they keep working as Apify retires old builds; the input types below are refreshed weekly and can lag an actor that changed its input since.

Extract LinkedIn post comments or comment replies in bulk, as well as comment social activities such as the number of likes and reactions. No cookies or account required

## Pricing

Pay per event — Post comment result $0.002, Main profile details $0.002, Full profile details $0.004, Full profile details + email search $0.01 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/harvestapi/linkedin-post-comments) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/harvestapi-linkedin-post-comments@0.1.0#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs: {}
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `posts` | array |  |  | Posts — Queries to search LinkedIn profiles by name. |
| `maxItems` | integer |  |  | Maximum number of comments to scrape per each post — Maximum number of comments to scrape per each post |
| `postedLimit` | string |  |  | Posted Limit (filter) — Fetch comments no older than X time. Options: '24h', 'week', 'month'. |
| `scrapeReplies` | boolean |  |  | Scrape Replies — Whether to scrape replies to comments. |
| `profileScraperMode` | string |  | `"short"` | Profile Scraper Mode — Choose the mode for scraping LinkedIn profiles. The Short mode provides basic information, while the Full mode includes full detailed profile data. |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
